description: Approve or deny approval requests in an organization room: the ids given, or with none given every request pending there now. Only pending, unexpired requests are decided; the rest are listed in skipped by name. The org's owner or a named approver only; agents never decide. Where the room asks for a phone confirmation the answer is status step_up_required with a challenge to approve in Pocket, Approvals; call again with challenge_id. Developer key or JWT.

approval_ids.description: The requests to decide (1 to 50); omit for every pending one

challenge_id.description: Optional: the challenge you approved on your phone for THIS decision

note.description: Optional: a note kept with the decision
